written: 2026-10-01, before any feature was built, any configuration was tuned or any test number was computed
hypothesis: A walk-forward logistic stack of ORR's in-season logit, ORR's preseason logit and an Elo logit (ratings.elo_run) beats ORR's in-season probability alone.

features.x_in: logit of the in-season filter's pregame P(home win) (ratings.run_filter + ratings.predict_probs, no starters)
features.x_pre: logit of the preseason-frozen P(home win) from the SAME filter run (predict_probs frozen=True: the season's starting prior, no in-season updates)
features.x_elo: logit of ratings.elo_run pregame P(home win) with the frozen orr/output/params/elo_hp.json (K=6, H=30, carry=0.7, MOV, playoffs)

variants.gs: frozen ratings_hp.json (use_shots=True), goals and shots in the update
variants.go: same with use_shots=False (goals-only, what the live loop runs while results carry no shots)

sources.ht: filter started from the team-history preseason table (games_bt), every season 2012-2024
sources.ship: filter started from the shipped market-anchored preseason ratings (inseason_bt: gamefile_bt.game_file_season, views mkt_rel82+td_rel82), seasons 2019, 2020, 2022-24; OT/SO parameters shared with the ht run of the same variant exactly as inseason_bt does

model: P(home win) = sigmoid(a + b_in x_in + b_pre x_pre + b_elo x_elo); intercept a unpenalised; minimise mean training log loss + lambda * penalty

family.to_base: penalty (b_in-1)^2 + b_pre^2 + b_elo^2 (shrinks to the in-season probability alone, intercept free)

regularisation_grid.note: lambda = 0 is the same model in both families and is counted once

walk_forward: the stack for season V is fitted on every season from 2012 to V-1 except 2013, ht features of the same variant

tuning.criterion: pooled log loss of the walk-forward stack over 2014-2017 games, chosen per variant; ties within 1e-6 go to the more regularised configuration
tuning.baseline_logged: in-season probability alone (x_in) on the same games

confirm.rule: reported once with the fixed configuration; does not change it. 2019 is NOT used to confirm because it is part of the gate test window.

test.primary: stack applied to the ship features (the loop as live) vs ship x_in alone, same variant, paired bootstrap 95% CI (orr.backtest.games_bt.paired); stack weights for test season V fitted on ht features of 2012..V-1 (2013 excluded), 2018 and 2021 included
secondary_reported_not_for_acceptance: the same stack applied to the ht features vs ht x_in alone (games_bt setting)
stack trained on ship features where they exist (2019, 2020, 2022, 2023) and ht otherwise, applied to ship
context: NeurHL-G p_stack and NeurHL Elo p_elo on the same games
test.runs: once, after the configuration is fixed

acceptance: PLAN_1_1 M2: accept if the stack improves on the same variant without it, with a 95% CI that excludes 0, for at least the goals-only variant. Evaluated on the primary comparison. If accepted, the stack is integrated for the goals-only loop; for goals-and-shots only if its own primary CI also excludes 0.

amendment_1.written: 2026-10-01, after stage-1 tuning on 2014-2017 and before any confirmation or test number
amendment_1.reason: In stage 1 every configuration was worse than the in-season probability alone on 2014-2017 (best +0.00040 gs, +0.00037 go). Even at lambda = 1 (slopes at (1,0,0)) the unpenalised intercept, fitted on earlier seasons, costs about 0.0004: it carries last seasons' home-win residual (+0.06 for 2014 trained on 2012 alone, -0.02 to -0.05 later), while the filter already tracks home ice in-season.

added_families.to_base_noint: intercept fixed at 0, penalty lambda * ((b_in-1)^2 + b_pre^2 + b_elo^2)

amendment_1.lambda: same grid; lambda = 0 counted for to_base_noint, not for to_base_int (it equals to_base lambda = 0)
amendment_1.selection: unchanged rule, over the union of stage 1 and stage 2 (19 + 19 = 38 configurations per variant, 76 in all)
amendment_1.unchanged: features, walk-forward, tuning seasons, confirmation, test protocol and acceptance rule
